name: Detection Engineering Portfolio - ATT&CK Coverage & Evasion Layer
description: Comprehensive MITRE ATT&CK coverage, validation status, and purple-team evasion hardening across Active Directory Intrusion (Scenario A) and Ransomware Precursor (Scenario B) chains.

legendItems.label: Active Sigma Detection with Regression Fixture (Medium-High Confidence)

techniques.comment: Rule: win_file_susp_download_file_drop.yml. Evasion tested against double extensions and script droppers. D3FEND: D3-FSA (File System Analysis).
Rule: win_proc_user_exec_untrusted_parent.yml. Evasion tested against PPID spoofing via system services. D3FEND: D3-PMA (Process Modification Analysis).
Rule: posh_pm_susp_script_block.yml. Evasion tested against Base64 encoding, alternate cradles, and in-memory AMSI bypass. D3FEND: D3-SEA (Script Execution Analysis).
Rule: win_proc_rundll32_susp_execution.yml. Detects Rundll32 executing untrusted DLLs from writable user directories. D3FEND: D3-PBA (Process Binary Analysis).
Rule: win_proc_hollowing_remote_thread.yml. Detects remote thread creation targeting critical system binaries. D3FEND: D3-PSA (Process Spawn Analysis).
Rule: win_proc_access_lsass_memory.yml. Evasion tested against renamed binaries (svchost masquerading). D3FEND: D3-CAI (Credential Access Interception).
Rule: win_sec_dc_replication_access.yml. Detects unauthorized DCSync directory replication requests on DC (EID 4662). D3FEND: D3-CAI.
Rule: win_sec_net_lateral_smb_admin_share.yml. Detects network access to IPC$, C$, and ADMIN$ shares across endpoints. D3FEND: D3-LMA (Lateral Movement Analysis).
Rule: win_proc_domain_account_recon.yml. Detects Active Directory domain user enumeration via net user /domain. D3FEND: D3-DAA (Domain Account Access).
Rule: win_proc_domain_trust_discovery.yml. Detects Active Directory domain and forest trust enumeration via nltest. D3FEND: D3-DTA (Domain Trust Analysis).
Rule: win_sec_anomalous_domain_logon.yml. Detects remote network logons (EID 4624 LogonType 3) using privileged domain accounts. D3FEND: D3-LAA (Logon Authentication Analysis).
Rule: win_sec_susp_rdp_lateral_logon.yml. Detects inbound Remote Desktop Protocol sessions (EID 4624 LogonType 10). D3FEND: D3-LMA (Lateral Movement Analysis).
Rule: win_schtask_suspicious_creation.yml. Detects creation of scheduled tasks executing script interpreters or unsigned payloads. D3FEND: D3-SJA (Scheduled Job Analysis).
Rule: win_registry_run_keys_persistence.yml. Detects registry modifications to Run and RunOnce autostart keys. D3FEND: D3-BRA (Boot Record Analysis).
Rules: win_proc_inhibit_system_recovery.yml & win_proc_vssadmin_resize_shadowstorage.yml. Evasion tested against multi-parent if_sid scoping (EID 4688 vs Sysmon 1). D3FEND: D3-FSA.
Rule: posh_tamper_defender_mp_preference.yml. Evasion tested against AMSI memory patches and PowerShell Defender disabling. D3FEND: D3-SPA (Security Policy Analysis).
Rule: win_file_mass_ransomware_activity.yml. Detects mass file creation with known ransomware extensions and rapid I/O handles. D3FEND: D3-FSA (File System Analysis).
Rule: win_sysmon_net_susp_c2_exfil.yml. Evasion tested against LOLBin substitution (certutil/bitsadmin over port 443). D3FEND: D3-NTA (Network Traffic Analysis).
Rule: posh_pm_obfuscated_script_block.yml. Detects base64 string decoding and dynamic reflection execution. D3FEND: D3-SEA (Script Execution Analysis).
Rule: win_proc_wmi_susp_command_exec.yml. Detects process call create execution commands invoked via wmic.exe. D3FEND: D3-PMA (Process Modification Analysis).
